name: Plain Card Data 25
definition: Sensible data associated with the payment card performing the transaction.

PAN.name: PAN
PAN.definition: Primary Account Number (PAN) of the card.

CardSequenceNumber.name: Card Sequence Number
CardSequenceNumber.definition: Identify a card or a payment token inside a set of cards with the same PAN.

EffectiveDate.name: Effective Date
EffectiveDate.definition: Date from which the card can be used, expressed either in the YYYY-MM format, or in the YYYY-MM-DD format.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Expiry date of the card expressed either in the YY-MM format, YYYY-MM format, or in the YYYY-MM-DD format.

ServiceCode.name: Service Code
ServiceCode.definition: Services attached to the card, as defined in ISO 7813.

Track1.name: Track 1
Track1.definition: ISO track 1 issued from the magnetic stripe card or from the ICC if the magnetic stripe was not read. The format is conform to ISO 7813, removing beginning and ending sentinels and longitudinal redundancy check characters.

Track2.name: Track 2
Track2.definition: ISO track 2 issued from the magnetic stripe card or from the ICC if the magnetic stripe was not read. The content is conform to ISO 7813, removing beginning and ending sentinels and longitudinal redundancy check characters.

Track3.name: Track 3
Track3.definition: ISO track 3 issued from the magnetic stripe card or from the ICC if the magnetic stripe was not read. The content is conform to ISO 4909, removing beginning and ending sentinels and longitudinal redundancy check characters.

CardholderName.name: Cardholder Name
CardholderName.definition: Name of the cardholder stored on the card.
